## RE:volution Mod v1.4.6

### Added

- Added runtime Mob Balance resolution for canonical `Mob<locationId>_<mobSlotId>` stage mobs through the active Balance Core snapshot.
- Added optional canonical overrides for mob `hp`, reward `resource`, and reward `amount` with independent persistence fallback for omitted fields.
- Added a balance-aware MobRepository decorator in the service layer while keeping repository packages ports-only and Mongo persistence unchanged.
- Added regression coverage for bundled-default compatibility, canonical and partial overrides, legacy mobs, the integer reward bridge, and invalid mob-balance data.

### Fixed

- Canonical mob HP and reward parameters no longer require direct Java changes when an explicit value is present in active balance data.
- Invalid non-positive HP/reward overrides and unknown reward resource ids are rejected instead of silently entering runtime state.
- The Mob Balance integration now uses the same active `BalanceService` snapshot as the migrated rune systems.

### Other

- The bundled v1.4.6 balance intentionally does not invent or replace current configured mob HP/reward values; persistence remains the fallback until an explicit override is published.
- Non-canonical/legacy mob names remain persistence-driven.
- Mob identity, type, models, textures, spawn coordinates, population, movement mode, zones, stage geometry, boss topology, and world topology remain outside Mob Balance.
- Existing physical mob lives are not rewritten mid-life; resolved values are picked up by workflows that reread definitions, such as respawn/load.
- Admin Balance Preview/Apply remains planned for v1.4.7. Population tuning, visual changes, and real-value rebalance are not part of v1.4.6.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifact published for this stable release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.4.5...v1.4.6
